g.text: Aliases: checklistUI = ChecklistPanel in UsedCarGUI / WorkspaceUI; worker = SwingWorker<ChecklistEvaluation,Void>; checklistCmd = GenerateChecklistCommand.
facade = UsedCarApplicationFacade; session = EvaluationSession; agent = UsedCarAgent; checker = DataQualityChecker; tools = ToolManager; knowledgeTool = VehicleKnowledgeTool.

repository = VehicleKnowledgeRepository; planner = ChecklistPlanner; promptBuilder = PromptBuilder; parser = ResponseParser. LLMClient is the interface implemented by the adapter, not a second client.
F10 never starts F11 automatically. User may separately open UML-07B. Filled arrows = synchronous calls; open arrows = UI events / worker scheduling; dashed arrows = returns.
Completion: current generation token + known item ID required; withCompletion
creates a new immutable envelope; return to GUI/CLI. No Gemini call.
Show saved preserves completion; regeneration resets it; changed saved Vehicle,
changed clarification facts or resolved listing needs invalidate old checklist state.
CLI checklist-show / checklist-mark <id> / checklist-unmark <id> are local.
Marking an item is user progress, not mechanical certification or proof of condition.
Parser: strict JSON; no duplicates; ≤64,000 characters; depth ≤5; 1–40 items/section.
Exactly six sections/five string fields; unique valid IDs, bounded text, valid priority.
validateChecklist: exact per-section membership/action/source, no lowered priority.
Reasons reject numeric miles/mi/mpg/USD relabelling and a fixed claim blacklist.
These are narrow integrity guards, not universal fact or conversion verification.
Unknown history is not interpreted as accident-free or complete maintenance.
1 Documents and vehicle history · 2 Exterior inspection
3 Interior inspection · 4 Engine and drivetrain inspection
5 Road test · 6 Questions to ask the seller
Planner fixes IDs/actions/sources and minimum priority; history stays a claim.
General checks, transmission guidance, missing-field questions and matched
local inspection notes are Java-controlled. No car-history API is queried.
sd A5 — constraints and lifecycle attached to A2 / A3 / A4
[stale] throw; do not save; GUI explains reload / regenerate.
[current] store result → worker return; done(): get(); showSaved().
alt revision and saved Vehicle still match
Agent returns ChecklistEvaluation(UUID, v, checklist, status, message,
knowledgeStatus, missing, completed=empty). Facade continues after A3.
InspectionChecklist is the item structure; ChecklistEvaluation is its evidence/status envelope.
sd A4 — guarded save, display, then separate local completion
Six required arrays; minItems=1; five string fields; High/Medium/Low.
No provider maxItems=40; the 40-item limit remains in Java.
Adapter checks configuration, timeout, HTTP status, STOP and text.
No credentials or raw provider error text appear in this diagram.
[provider failure] FALLBACK baseline + safe LLMFailure diagnostic.
[parse / membership / priority / unit / phrase rejection] FALLBACK baseline.
Generic RuntimeException during request → baseline and generic message.
alt synthesis outcome — one attempt, no automatic retry
build(v,k,missing) [general rebuild only if needed; A2]
sd A3 — ChecklistPlanner → constrained synthesis → Java acceptance or deterministic fallback
withListingNeeds adds unresolved listing targets to missing/uncertain evidence.
Repository loads bundled vehicle-knowledge.csv lazily (fictional teaching data).
[match] attributed local notes; [no match] VehicleKnowledge.noData(), general guidance.
[tool failure] k=null; explicit unavailable knowledgeStatus; no invented reliability data.
Next: planner.build(v,k,missing) → baseline. If local notes make the plan invalid,
catch IllegalArgumentException, set k=null and rebuild with general guidance.
sd A2 — deterministic evidence, then authoritative plan
CLI: submit(new GenerateChecklistCommand(facade)) → execute(); no SwingWorker.
Under session lock: currentVehicle() → saved v; session.beginChecklist(v) → revision;
listingClarifications() → listingNeeds. beginChecklist clears the old generation.
No saved v → IllegalStateException; GUI precheck instead shows “Save a vehicle…”.
Only the saved Vehicle is used; unsaved F01 edits are not included.
sd A1 — explicit generation; GUI worker, or CLI checklist
UML-07A — F10 checklist planning, Gemini synthesis and local completion | UC10 / SD05 | 48fe916 | A1 → A2 → A3 → A4
Figure 3.7 — SD05: Inspection Checklist and Clarification Loop
